현재 슬레이어들의 집결지는 마을의 관공서 건물이다. 제군들이 사용할 모든: The current rally point for Slayers is the town's government building. All weapons and equipment you will use are issued from there first. Refrain from acting alone, and move in groups whenever possible! A great many locals have already fallen victim to the vampires. Yet many more are still unable to escape this area due to the regional lockdown. Do not forget that their safety is also part of your mission. See to it that no more people lose their homes and families and are left to wander because of the vampires. This operation isn't a matter of facing one or two vampires — you'll be up against overwhelming numbers, so be especially careful, and keep that in mind! Should you ever be bitten by a vampire, take your own life in accordance with our code... good luck to you.
Understood. I'll be on my way then.
이곳 에슬라니안에서 뱀파이어의 움직임이 포착되었다. 정보원에 의하면 이들: Vampire activity has been detected here in Eslania. According to our intelligence, they are currently searching for something and, unfortunately, are able to move about unaffected by sunlight. Whether by coincidence or not, vampire masters scattered across the world also seem to be converging on this region. Their appearance has us all on high alert. The Eslanian government found itself unable to counter the monsters' appearance with regular military firepower. Upon learning that these creatures were vampires, they have since placed the region and the press under strict control. The Eslanian prime minister requested help from the Pope, and the Pope in turn came to us. Our leadership, already on edge over the masters' movements, secretly dispatched a handful of agents, but contact with them has since been lost. So this time, every Slayer currently available for deployment will be committed to this operation. With the press and the region both locked down, conditions are favorable for our activities. I believe this is truly a fine opportunity to demonstrate our capabilities. I expect great things from all of you.
그럼 간단한 지역 브리핑에 들어가겠다. 이번 작전이 펼쳐질 지역은 에슬라: Now then, let's move on to a brief regional briefing. The area where this operation will take place, Helea in Eslania, is renowned for its rugged mountains and scenery, but it's such a remote region that few people pass through. Most of the residents don't depend on tourism for income and instead live by methods such as slash-and-burn farming. The general education level of the residents is low, and their standard of living is the lowest anywhere in Eslania. Helea's land is vast, but with almost no flatland, it's home to only five settlements too small to really be called cities. It seems the vampires have appeared in the vicinity of these very settlements. Though these settlements are barely 200 kilometers from the capital, the rugged terrain and poor road access have apparently made it easy to keep the region and the press under lockdown. There are five villages in total, each situated roughly 10 kilometers apart from one another, centered around Eslanian City.
It sounds like ideal conditions for carrying out an operation. Please, tell me more.
현재까지의 정보를 종합하자면 마스터들은 속속 그 지역으로 숨어 들고 있다: Putting together all the information gathered so far, it seems the masters are steadily going into hiding throughout that region. It's said they rest in lairs prepared by their subordinates while having those subordinates search for something. Their lairs apparently form a ring encircling the villages. The trouble is, all twelve of them are converging there. In all recorded history, there has never once been a case of all twelve masters gathering together. We don't know what it is they're searching for, but it must be extremely important — important enough, it seems, to be enabling the vampires in that region to move about during the day. Whatever it is, it must be something tremendous, both for the vampires and for us. Your mission is to seize whatever it is the masters are searching for, and eliminate the masters themselves if at all possible.
제 임무를 잘 알겠습니다. 다른 지시사항은 없으십니까?: I understand my mission clearly. Are there any other instructions?
가상 훈련장은 처음 교육 받는 자들을 위한 곳이다. 넓은 숲을 이용한 장: The virtual training ground is meant for those receiving instruction for the first time. It's a wide, forested area, and dangers can lurk anywhere during combat in the woods. It will help you to check your information and level from time to time during engagements. Press Ctrl + I for the information window, and Ctrl + K for the level window. Once you reach level 5, you can learn skills from the instructors on the third floor of each guild in Eslanian City. Any other questions?
E.V.E 란 어떤 조직입니까?: What kind of organization is E.V.E.?
I'll listen to the briefing first.
브리핑 내용을 듣지 않았다면 듣고 출발하는 것이 좋을 것 같군. 상황이: If you haven't heard the briefing yet, you should listen before heading out. Given the state of things, you need to be fully briefed before entering combat. There's no telling how many vampires are added in a single day. Your contribution matters now more than ever... If you have questions, I'll answer them so long as they fall within what you're cleared to know. What would you like to ask?
죄송합니다만, E.V.E 란 어떤 조직입니까?: Excuse me, but what kind of organization is E.V.E.?
아까도 말했지만, 내 이름은 E.V.E 의 제 2 용병부대의 부대장, 이: As I said before, I am Kaiser Heinrich, captain of E.V.E.'s 2nd Mercenary Company and commander of this operation. First, go to Tanya for information on weapons, then get your weapon issued from Jacques. Once you leave this place, no one will be able to give you the weapon that is as vital as your own life, so make sure you don't forget it! Any other questions?
뱀파이어들은 기본적으로 죽어있는 몸이라서, 웬만한 총이나 칼을 맞고도 금: Vampires are fundamentally dead bodies to begin with, so of course you already know that they can recover almost instantly from most bullets or blades, right, rookie! That is a basic principle you must never forget. Plenty of men have died turning their backs on a vampire without finishing it off completely. This instructor nearly died because of that very mistake himself. Right, you've got a look on your face like you've got something to ask. Any questions?
I have something I'd like to ask.
Yes. Please explain the difference between a sword and a saber.
아.. AR, SMG, SG, SR의 정확한 의미는 무엇입니까?: Ah.. what exactly do AR, SMG, SG, and SR stand for?
십자가와 메이스는 어떻게 다릅니까?: How do a cross and a mace differ?
제가 선택할 수 있는 무기는 무엇무엇이 있습니까?: What weapons are available for me to choose from?
I've come to learn skills related to firearms. Please teach me.
I'd like to exchange my instructor's notebook.
Not even knowing the difference between a sword and a saber. A real greenhorn, aren't you. Well, I suppose that's understandable.. A sword is relatively light and double-edged, so it can both cut and thrust. But you shouldn't count on thrusting to work against vampires. They're already dead, so it won't even hurt them. Unless you pierce the heart in one strike and kill it instantly, you won't even be able to pull your blade back out, which puts the attacker in danger. So whether it's a light sword or a heavy saber, the safest bet is to swing with all your strength and cleave it in two, reducing its attack power or mobility. A saber is single-edged, heavier than a sword, and slower to swing, but it can split a vampire in half in a single blow. Understand?
I'd like to know the difference between AR, SMG, SG, and SR.
십자가와 메이스는 둘다 비슷한 것 같은데.. 어떻게 다릅니까?: The cross and the mace seem pretty similar to me.. how are they different?
Understood. I'll choose my weapon now.
AR은 소총(Assault Rifle)이다. 보통 총이라고 하면 대체로: AR stands for Assault Rifle. When people say 'gun' in general, they usually mean an assault rifle. It's a standard weapon with decent firepower and decent accuracy. It's also the weapon most Slayers carry. Next, SMG stands for Sub Machine Gun, a compact rifle used by counter-terrorism units and special forces. It's light and easy to carry, but its downside is somewhat reduced firepower. SG stands for ShotGun, which, as you already know, fires buckshot. Used up close, it can shred a vampire to ribbons in an instant. SR is short for Sniper Rifle, and just as the name implies, it's used to blow off a vampire's head or heart from a distance. Next?
자크.. 검과 도에 대해서 설명해주실 수 있습니까?: Jacques.. could you explain the sword and the saber to me?
십자가와 메이스라.. 이 무기들은 무엇입니까? 중세 시대도 아니고.. 원: A cross and a mace.. what kind of weapons are these? This isn't the Middle Ages, honestly..
Please let me choose my weapon.
Haha.. I don't need a weapon to take down a mere vampire. Well then, take care.
십자가와 메이스라.. 이건 솔직히 내 분야는 아니다. 보통 바티칸의 성직: The cross and the mace.. honestly, that's not really my area. Those are usually weapons used by Slayers who came from the priesthood in the Vatican.. Priests who carry crosses tend to have powerful healing and curative abilities.. and I believe the mace is for priests who use blessing-type magic. These weapons are said to be specially crafted directly by the Holy See, which is why they deal fatal damage to vampires. For more detail, ask one of the other rookies who came from the Vatican. Next?
Please explain the difference between a sword and a saber.
AR, SMG, SG, SR의 정확한 의미는 무엇입니까?: What exactly do AR, SMG, SG, and SR stand for?
Thank you for the explanation, Mr. Jacques. I'll see you next time.
결정했나? 도중에 다른 무기로 바꿔도 되니까 그렇게 고민하지 않아도 되네: Made up your mind? You can always switch to a different weapon later, so there's no need to agonize over it. Now, which weapon will you go with? Hmm... do you know how to equip and use the weapon you're issued? It wouldn't do for a soldier heading into combat not to know how to equip and use his own weapon. Watch my demonstration closely so you make no mistakes out in the field. Your issued weapon is inside the inventory, which pops up when you press the TAB key. Bring up this inventory alongside the gear window, where you can equip weapons, by pressing CTRL + TAB, then drag the item from your inventory onto the appropriate slot in the gear window. If an equipped item appears in red, it means your stats fall short of the item's requirements, which is why it shows up red. Keep in mind that you'll need to raise your stats if you want to make proper use of the item. To use your weapon, left-click the mouse. You're still a beginner, so train hard, check your level with Ctrl + K, and once you reach level 5, you can learn skills from the instructors on the third floor of each guild in Eslanian City.
I'll choose the light, fast sword.
I'll choose the heavy but high-damage saber.
죄송합니다만, 자크. 다시 한번 설명해 주시겠습니까?: I'm sorry, Jacques, but could you explain that once more?
흠. 이번의 신입은 궁금해 하는 점이 상당히 많군. 그래, 제군? 무엇이: Hmm. This new recruit sure has a lot of questions. Well, soldier? What is it you're so eager to know?
Mr. Jacques. Please explain the difference between a sword and a saber.
AR, SMG, SG, SR은 무엇의 약자입니까?: What do AR, SMG, SG, and SR stand for?
Ah, I understand now. Please let me choose my weapon.
제 인벤토리를 보면 무기이외에 앰플이 있던데.. 어떤 용도로 사용하는 것: I see there are ampoules in my inventory besides my weapon.. what are they used for?
Huh? Our records show you already received a weapon earlier.. is that not right? You.. are you trying to pull one over on me!
I'm sorry, Mr. Jacques. Please forgive me.
무기들의 자세한 정보들은 타냐에게 가보면 컴퓨터를 이용해 쉽게 검색할 수: For detailed information on weapons, go see Tanya — she can easily look things up for you on her computer. Be sure to stop by. Good luck out there.
궁금한 것이 뭔가 제군?: What is it you want to know, soldier?
E.V.E 에 오기전에는 무슨 일을 하셨습니까?: What did you do before coming to E.V.E.?
I heard you used to live as a mercenary. I'd like to know more about mercenaries.
내 이름은 자크 베르뮐렌이다. 이곳 사령부에서 자네들에게 적당한 무기들과: My name is Jacques Vermeulen. Here at headquarters, I issue you suitable weapons and a bit of money. Anything else you'd like to know?
내가 군에 입대하자마자 월남전에 참전, 전세계의 대부분의 전장을 누비고: The moment I enlisted, I was sent off to fight in the Vietnam War, and from there I roamed across most of the world's battlefields. Finally, I ended my mercenary career with the French Foreign Legion and went into seclusion, until Captain Kaiser, whom I'd fought alongside before, persuaded me to come here recently. Anything else?
용병은 보수를 받는 댓가로 복무하는 군인을 말한다. 충성심이 부족하고 우: A mercenary is a soldier who serves in exchange for pay. Their weakness is a lack of loyalty and a scarcity of truly skilled individuals among their ranks, but they've long been used since ancient times to protect a nation's people or supplement a shortage of troops. Beyond issues of loyalty or quality, since mercenaries are hired for money, they may switch sides at any time, friend or foe, depending on pay or other contract terms. Since mercenaries are usually foreigners, this often causes plenty of friction when living or carrying out joint operations alongside a nation's own soldiers. At present, aside from the Vatican's Swiss Guard, the French Foreign Legion is well known as a mercenary force. Understand now, soldier?
There are two kinds of ampoules: the red healing ampoule and the blue mana ampoule. Use them while keeping an eye on the two bars — health and mana — that appear in the upper left of the interface. If you don't have a belt, you can use an ampoule by opening your inventory and right-clicking it. Ampoules can also be assigned to hotkeys for convenience — buy a belt item from a shop and drag the ampoule onto it. Depending on the number of pockets, you can assign them to hotkeys from F1 up to F8. When you sense danger, inject a healing ampoule to restore your health, and use the blue mana ampoule to replenish the magic power consumed when using skills.
Understood. I won't forget this once I'm out in the field.
뱀파이어들을 만나면 꼭 심장을 박살내버린 다음, 목을 날려버리도록. 알겠: When you face a vampire, be sure to shatter its heart first, then take off its head. Understand?
결국 총도 다른 검, 도같은 무기들처럼 자신의 신체의 일부처럼 익숙해져야: In the end, a gun, just like a sword or a saber, needs to feel like an extension of your own body.
When you address me, always call me Mr. Jacques.
Recruits are to come to me, state their rank and name, and then receive their weapon.
You must remain quiet while receiving a briefing from Captain Kaiser.
총을 그따위로 다루다니. 그런 정신으로 무얼 하겠나. 제군!: Handling a gun like that. With that attitude, what do you expect to accomplish, soldier!
카이저 부대장님이 아니었다면, 나는 아마 폐인이 되었을거야. 항상 그분께: If it weren't for Captain Kaiser, I probably would have ended up a broken man. I'm forever grateful to him..
With my own two hands, I'll...
세계 곳곳을 누비고 돌아다녔지만, 이 곳만큼 그녀석들이 활개치고 다니는: I've traveled all over the world, but I've never seen those things run so wild anywhere like they do here.
더 알고 싶다면 타냐에게 가보도록 하게. 직접 원하는 무기정보를 검색할: If you want to know more, go see Tanya. You'll be able to look up whatever weapon information you need yourself.
장난이라고 생각하지말게. 실전이라는 걸 항상 명심하도록!: Don't think of this as a game. Always keep in mind that this is the real thing!
자네는 뱀파이어의 진정한 의미를 알고 있는가? 하긴 자네는 아직 어려서: Do you truly understand what a vampire is? Well, I suppose you're still young, so it's only natural you wouldn't yet grasp their true nature. Of course, fighting them with guns and blades is important, but there are moments when approaching the secrets of those immortals on an intellectual level matters even more. Not only are they individually immortal, but their kind as a species is immortal as well. You might manage to burn one or two of them to death, but to annihilate them entirely... hmm.. ah.. forgive me. Something else just occurred to me that I need to research. If you look through these books, you'll come to understand a little about the vampires you'll be fighting from here on. Well then..
잠시만요. 저. 당신은 누구시길래 뱀파이어들에 대해서 그렇게 소상히 알고: Wait, just a moment. Who exactly are you, to know so much about vampires in such detail?
제가 읽을 만한 책들을 소개해 주시겠습니까?: Could you recommend some books worth reading?
내가 내 소개를 안했던가? 미안하네. 그냥 카인이라고 불러주게. 그럼 나: Did I not introduce myself? My apologies. Just call me Cain. Now then, I must be off to my research.
Understood. I'll take a look at these books here for a while, then.
Thank you for the information. I'll be on my way now.
나는 여기 E.V.E에 얽매인 몸은 아니라네. 단지 객원 연구원일 뿐이지: I'm not actually bound to E.V.E. here. I'm merely a guest researcher.
다양한 매체들의 정보를 취합해보면 세상이 얼마나 음모에 가득차 있는지 알: If you gather information from a wide range of sources, you'll see just how full of conspiracies this world really is.
세상의 대부분의 조직들은 다 뱀파이어들과 조금씩 연관을 맺고 있다는 조사: Investigations have shown that nearly every organization in the world has some degree of connection to the vampires.
If you read through these books carefully, you'll come to know a fair amount about vampires.
타냐같은 딸이 있다면 정말 좋겠네. 예쁘지. 똑똑하지. 그런데 왜 아직: It would be wonderful to have a daughter like Tanya. She's pretty. She's smart. So why doesn't she have a boyfriend yet, I wonder?
If you happen to find any old books while out on a mission, be sure to bring them to me.
I'm Tanya Serrano. How can I help you?
I have something I'd like to ask you.
I'd like to take part in the virtual training system.
무기 정보를 검색하려는데 좀 도와주시겠습니까?: I'd like to look up weapon information — could you help me?
It was nice meeting you, Tanya.
제게... 뭐가 궁금하신가요?: What is it... you'd like to know from me?
타냐, 당신이 이곳에서 하는 일은 무엇입니까?: Tanya, what is it that you do here?
E.V.E 에는 어떻게 오시게 되었나요?: How did you come to join E.V.E.?
전 E.V.E 내에서 정보전략을 담당하고 있습니다. 현재는 이곳 임시사령: Within E.V.E., I'm in charge of information strategy. Right now I've come to this temporary headquarters to act as a helper, making it easier for Slayers to search for weapon information. Have you already heard about the current situation in Eslania? If you go to Captain Kaiser, you can receive a detailed briefing.
우연히 해킹한 CIA 컴퓨터에 국가기밀이라고 되어있던 문서를 좀 보게되었: It happened while I was hacking into a CIA computer, sort of by chance — I came across some documents marked as state secrets. The content of that secret was just unbelievable. It was about CIA agents involved with vampires. It described how, since the vampires had trouble moving during the day, a few agents were handling certain matters on their behalf. There were piles of phone call logs, transaction records, and documents. The more I clicked through, the more thrilling it got. I remember thinking, to think I'd get caught up in something like this... and kept reading through the files until... I got traced and my location was exposed. That was my mistake. Government agents showed up and used what I'd seen to bargain with me. They dug up a drug charge from two years ago and threatened me with life imprisonment. They laid down joining E.V.E. as a condition... so I had no choice but to accept and end up here.
무기를 지급받으시려면 자크씨에게 가 보세요. 그분은 컴퓨터 못지 않게 무: To receive your weapon, go see Mr. Jacques. He knows just as much about weapons as any computer does... you'll be able to get plenty of information from him. Oh, right! To check how to use an item you own, press the TAB key to open your inventory, then click the magnifying glass button at the bottom. Click on the item you want information about, and a brief explanation of how to use it will appear. Keep that in mind as you play. Well then.. good luck out there.
힐계열을 배우시겠습니까? 인챈트 계열을 배우시겠습니까?: Would you like to learn Healing skills, or Enchantment skills?
Rather than skills, I'd like to know what you do here.
기술은 나중에 배우도록 하겠습니다. 그런데.. E.V.E 에는 어떻게 오: I'll learn skills later. By the way.. how did you come to join E.V.E.?
기술연마보다는 무기 정보를 검색하려는데 좀 도와주시겠습니까?: Rather than training skills, I'd like to look up weapon information — could you help me?
I'll learn skills later. It was nice meeting you, Tanya.
컴퓨터는 단지 컴퓨터일 뿐입니다. 그걸 사용하는 사람이야말로 정말 뛰어난: A computer is just a computer. It's the person using it who truly makes the difference.
하긴 요즘은 컴퓨터보다 못한 인간들도 많으니깐요. 컴퓨터는 최소한 정직하: Then again, there are plenty of people these days who are worse than computers. At least a computer is honest.
Use this computer to look up weapon information.
자크씨에게 무기를 받으시는 것을 잊지 마세요. 무기를 가지고 가지 않았다: Don't forget to receive your weapon from Mr. Jacques. I've seen a few people come back after leaving without one.
You can't call some script kiddie a hacker.
I'm Tanya, in charge of information strategy.
Ask me about anything you don't know. I'll give you as much information as I can provide.
Have you gotten a general explanation from Captain Kaiser? If not, go see him. He'll tell you a lot of important things.
항상 긴장하는 것을 잊지마세요. 느긋했다가.. 목이 달아난 사람 여럿봤으: Never let your guard down. I've seen quite a few people lose their heads after getting too relaxed...
무기에 대해서는 자크씨도 컴퓨터 못지 않답니다. 더 알고 싶은 게 있으면: When it comes to weapons, Mr. Jacques knows just as much as a computer does. If you want to learn more, going to see him would help too.
이 시콜스키의 기장 매튜 그레엄 소령이다. 필요하다면 맷이라 불러도 좋지: I'm Major Matthew Graham, pilot of this Sikorsky. You may call me Matt if you like, but call me Captain while we're in flight. Where would you like to go?
I'd like to go to Perona Highway.
I'd like to go to the Free Combat Zone.
I've come to borrow the Sigil of the Blood Scripture.
I'll return the Sigil of the Blood Scripture.
I'm just having a look around. Sorry to bother you.
